notice: Demonstration data: every announcement below is fictional and was written to show how the Staff Bulletin works. These are not real University of Tennessee or University Housing communications.

announcements.title: [Demo] Building staff meeting moved to Thursday
announcements.description: This week's building staff meeting moves from Tuesday to Thursday evening in the main lounge. Bring your floor updates and any questions for your Hall Director.

announcements.title: [Demo] Winter break closing checklists due
announcements.description: Complete your floor's winter break closing checklist and return it to the front desk. Your Hall Director will share the checklist at the next staff meeting.

announcements.title: [Demo] December floor program proposals
announcements.description: Submit your December floor program idea to your Assistant Hall Director for review. Include the event title, a short description, and the date you have in mind.

announcements.title: [Demo] One-on-one sign-ups are open
announcements.description: Sign up for a 20-minute one-on-one with your Hall Director using the sheet posted in the staff office.

announcements.title: [Demo] Front desk schedule swap requests
announcements.description: Need to swap a front desk shift before Thanksgiving break? Post your request in the staff group chat and confirm the swap with your Assistant Hall Director.

announcements.title: [Demo] Bulletin board theme for December
announcements.description: December bulletin boards should focus on finals-week wellness and study resources. Supplies are available in the staff office.

announcements.title: [Demo] Mid-semester resident check-in forms
announcements.description: Complete a brief check-in conversation with each resident on your floor and turn in your summary sheet to your Hall Director.

announcements.title: [Demo] Staff office supply restock
announcements.description: The staff office supply cabinet has been restocked with markers, tape, and poster paper for floor events and door decorations.
